description: This PHP class implements a calendar provider that stores and manages calendar events as JSON files. It includes methods for testing connection, loading, saving, creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving events, as well as mapping JSON data to domain objects.

classes.name: JsonFileCalendarProvider
classes.description: A PHP class that provides calendar event management by reading and writing events stored in JSON files, extending AbstractCalendarProvider.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to the JSON file storage by verifying directory writability and loading events.

methods.name: initializeFilePath
methods.description: Sets up the file path for storing calendar data based on connection and user ID, creating directories if necessary.

methods.name: loadEvents
methods.description: Loads events from the JSON file into memory, handling file absence, read errors, and JSON parsing errors.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events matching a query by loading from JSON and filtering based on query criteria.

methods.name: mapToCalendarAccountEvent
methods.description: Maps JSON event data to a CalendarAccountEvent object, extracting relevant fields.

methods.name: matchesQuery
methods.description: Checks if an event matches the date range specified in a query.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event by adding it to the JSON file.

methods.name: generateEventId
methods.description: Generates a unique event ID based on a prefix, a unique ID, and timestamp.

methods.name: mapFromCalendarAccountEvent
methods.description: Converts a CalendarAccountEvent object into an array suitable for JSON storage.

methods.name: saveEvents
methods.description: Saves the current events array to the JSON file.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event by ID from the JSON storage.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event in the JSON storage.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event by ID from the JSON storage.
